column3: Upon the BioMed MIT Portfolio Mortgage Loan becoming a specially serviced loan under the BX 2025-LIFE TSA, the related Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the BX 2025-LIFE TSA will earn a special servicing fee payable monthly with respect to the BioMed MIT Portfolio Mortgage Loan accruing at a rate equal to 0.15% per annum.
